title: JGU Mainz's Submission to the AmericasNLP 2024 Shared Task on the Creation of Educational Materials for Indigenous Languages

live_model.evidence: Sec 3.3: "we leverage the gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 version of GPT-4", used with ICL (k=20) matching the Mixtral prompt style.

prompt.location: Figure 2 (1-shot prompt example; GPT-4 explicitly "maintain[s] consistency in example selection and prompt style with Mixtral 8x7B")

claim.location: Table 2 only reports ensembles: (1) LSTMs+Mixtrals+GPT4s vs. (2) LSTMs+Mixtrals vs. (3) LSTMs vs. (4) Mixtrals; GPT-4 never appears as its own row

data.source: AmericasNLP 2024 shared task data (Bribri, Guarani, Maya; sizes in Table 1)

notes: GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09 is pinned, role S, prompt fully shown, and data is public, but the paper only reports majority-vote ensemble accuracies that blend GPT-4 with two other systems; the sole isolatable signal is that ensemble (1) (with GPT-4) beats ensemble (2) (without it) only on Guarani (dev 49.36->53.16 acc., test 23.08->34.62 acc.), which is not a standalone GPT-4 accuracy figure.
